frozen_forecast.expected_path: An uneven rebound-and-retest path is more defensible than a clean trend. Initial resilience may persist, but negative settled flows, contracting liquidity capacity and unresolved ETH-relative strength leave advances vulnerable to fading. Downside risk is elevated, without sufficient evidence for a confident net decline across the full 72 hours.
falsification_conditions: Sustained price gains, improving ETH/BTC and repeated broad participation, supported by better settled flows when available, would favor an UP interpretation over MIXED.
Persistent synchronized BTC and ETH weakness with shrinking participation would favor DOWN over the rebound-and-retest interpretation.
A sustained, narrow trading range without directional follow-through would favor SIDEWAYS rather than the expected alternating rebound and retest.
missing_evidence: Fresh multi-hour and daily price structure showing whether the latest advance holds.
Repeated breadth measurements and ETH/BTC observations establishing persistence or deterioration.
New settled-flow evidence and updated liquidity observations; no future flow result is assumed.
Sufficient derivatives and spot-flow history to distinguish durable demand from temporary positioning adjustments.
